title: rbac-v2: enforce KMS region residency & audit logging hardening
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Compliance customers require enforced KMS key region residency and stronger audit trails for cross-region key usage. This PR updates RBAC v2 policy evaluation to support region-pinning constraints on KMS-backed resources, surfaces audit events for policy bypass/fallback, and introduces a migration path + feature flag for gradual rollout.

What this PR does (high-level):
- Adds 'kms:region' constraint to RBAC v2 policy language and evaluator so policies can require keys to be provisioned in allowed regions.
- Enforces residency at request-evaluation time and at runtime for request routing (pre-check early-fail).
- Emits new structured audit events for: policy evaluation result, KMS key region mismatch, automatic fallback routing, and customer-visible policy rejections. Events contain key metadata (key id, key region, resource, request id, principal).
- Integrates with KMS residency configuration in Private deployments and the Dedicated control plane: KMS checks consult the configured residency map and fail-fast when invalid.
- Adds a feature flag `rbac_v2.kms_region_enforcement` (off by default) + a migration tool to scan existing policies and surface candidates that will be impacted.
- Docs + Terraform examples updated for policy authoring and operator rollout steps.

Checklist:
- [x] RBAC policy language change + evaluator unit tests
- [x] Runtime enforcement hook and early-fail path
- [x] Structured audit event schema + logger plumbing
- [x] Integration tests against mocked KMS service
- [x] Migration scanner and UX notes for operators
- [x] Doc updates in redwood-docs and rbac-policy-bundle
- [x] Backwards compat check: policy without kms:region remains valid (no enforcement until feature flag enabled)

Risks & mitigations:
- Incorrect policy enforcement could block traffic: default feature-flag OFF and staged rollout (canary + org opt-in).
- Performance: added a single metadata lookup to policy evaluation; microbenchmarked and saw <1% p95 latency change under typical workloads.
- Audit verbosity: events are structured and can be routed to existing audit sinks; samples/filters added in console to reduce noise.

Priya: 'How does this interact with legacy policies with explicit key ARNs pinned to regions?' - Response: migration scanner flags ARNs and suggests replacing with policy-level kms:region constraints; added helper script.
Luca: 'Audit schema needs consistent field names across services.' - Response: normalized field names to match existing audit spec (resource_id, principal_id, key_id, key_region, request_id, verdict). Updated docs.
